notes.title: New patch: Key bindings changes & control fixes
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35662470/78dfcb0de17c0b9d192b49ed9b9ef9a840c943dd.jpg[/img]

Hey Aces!

A new [i]Red Wings: Aces of the Sky[/i] patch is live!

The patch implements long requested key binding features along with new screen designs. 

[h3]Read the full list of fixes here:[/h3]
[list]
[*] added key bindings for standard controls (keyboard and mouse)
[*] added bindings for HOTAS controllers
[*] added button mapping (all functions for keyboard, pads, and flightstick can be found under “Controls”)
[*] added a new design of the loading and pause screens showing controls
[/list]

Thank you for all your suggestions so far. Feel free to share even more suggestions or your impressions in our [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1140630/discussions/]Steam Discussions[/url] and on our [url=https://discord.com/invite/m5zhV5hzzW]Discord[/url] server.

If you enjoy the game, please also consider dropping us a review. They help us a lot!

notes.title: New Patch - Main menu mouse support & resolution fixes
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35662470/93a4537f8af0444c28826956ce4e8b284c01bfb9.png[/img]

[h3]Pilots![/h3]
You can now enjoy the benefits of a new Red Wings: Aces of the Sky patch! 

The patch introduces an often-requested feature: main menu mouse support. Additionally, a full support for 16:9 and 16:10 display resolutions is now available and some minor fixes were implemented.

Thank you for all of your fantastic suggestions so far. Please don’t stop sharing your impressions in our [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1140630/discussions/]Steam Discussions[/url] and on the [url=https://discord.com/invite/CPUcUZc]Discord[/url] server.

If you enjoy the game, please also consider dropping us an honest review. They help us a lot!

notes.title: Watch the new trailer and discover the release date!
notes.notes:
[h3]Attention, pilots![/h3]
We’re flying straight at you with amazing news—[i]Red Wings: Aces of the Sky[/i] has targeted a release date! Get your aviator hats and goggles ready for sky-high thrills on [b]October 13[/b]. 

Watch the trailer to see what the game has to offer:

[previewyoutube=1Cj2NIufoQM;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]What The Critics Say[/h3]
[i]Red Wings: Aces of the Sky[/i] first premiered on Nintendo Switch and was very well received by critics who emphasized the game’s addictive arcade-style gameplay, great visuals, and immersive audio. Here are some of the reviews:

[url=https://www.nintendoworldreport.com/review/53796/red-wings-aces-of-the-sky-switch-review]Red Wings: Aces of the Sky (Switch) Review - Arcade action done very right[/url]
Red Wings: Aces of the Sky [i]is a surprisingly addictive game. It is a prime example of a very 
simple gameplay loop executed extremely well.[/i]
- Nintendo World Report

[url=https://www.bonusstage.co.uk/2020/05/25/red-wings-aces-of-the-sky-review/]Red Wings: Aces of the Sky Review[/url]
[i]Overall, Red Wings: Aces of the Sky is another great example of an arcade-styled, combat flight simulation based around the Great War. All of its components, from presentations to controls and graphical and audio qualities, combine to produce an infinitely satisfying experience for fans of its genre.[/i]
- Bonus Stage

[url=https://cogconnected.com/review/red-wings-switch-review/]Red Wings: Aces of the Sky Review – Fly like an eagle[/url]
[i]I love everything about the setting of Red Wings. All In! Games does a fantastic job of encapsulating the player in the old-timey, war-ridden era that its subject matter is based on, using vivid, warm colors and period-piece music.[/i]
- COGconnected

[h3]A Demo Will Hit Steam Soon![/h3]
In addition, a game demo will be available at the Steam Game Festival, from October 7-13. The Red Baron shot his first enemy plane down in September 1915—you can take down your first enemy in October 2020 with four levels of the German campaign, in three different planes! Don’t worry about the difficulty, the demo will cover you with a tutorial.
